job_root.description: Job queue directory used with render.start. Optional: defaults to .cutbolt/jobs in the workspace.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_status

tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued/running job without deleting final output. Poll until cancelled or completed; publication can win a simultaneous cancellation. Safe to repeat for the same job.

job_id.description: Job ID from the render.start ticket.

job_root.description: Job queue directory used with render.start. Optional: defaults to .cutbolt/jobs in the workspace.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_cancel

tools.description: Reconcile saved publication and wake the queue worker to drain queued jobs, including explicitly opted-in interrupted retries within their saved attempt limit. Completed, cancelled and exhausted jobs are not rerun.

job_root.description: Job queue directory used with render.start. Optional: defaults to .cutbolt/jobs in the workspace.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_resume

tools.description: Queue a long-running command in the background and return a durable ticket: export.run (H.264/AAC or lossless delivery), export.review (a review folder for a rendered cut), captions.render (generated caption edits or a compiled overlay), graphics.place (save a generated graphic clip in one edit), media.transcribe (a whole file's speech into transcripts, or a known script aligned to it), media.prepare (any camera or phone file to a timeline asset, optionally for a project's rate and size), media.conform, scene.render, audio.render, audio.repair.render, hdr.conform, image.sequence.compile, proxy.generate, preview.range, cache.run or transcript.transcribe. Arguments are prepared and validated now. Follow with job.wait or job.status; the result holds the command's receipt. Independent jobs run at once, so queue several, then wait for them all with one job.wait job_ids; job.cancel stops one.

arguments.description: That command's arguments exactly as for a direct call, without `command`; cutbolt_schema with its name gives the schema.

job_root.description: Existing local directory holding the job queue (jobs.sqlite3). Optional: defaults to .cutbolt/jobs in the workspace.

request_id.description: Caller-chosen ID unique within job_root, 1-128 bytes. An identical resubmission returns the original ticket.

run.description: Command to run in the background: graphics.place, export.run, export.review, captions.render, media.prepare, media.transcribe, media.conform, scene.render, audio.render, audio.repair.render, hdr.conform, image.sequence.compile, proxy.generate, preview.range, cache.run or transcript.transcribe.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_start

tools.description: Wait up to timeout_seconds (default 30, at most 120) for a queued or running job to finish, then return its status, progress and result, with finished true or false. With job_ids, wait for several jobs in one call, until all (default) or any have finished: the result counts jobs by status and lists each job's receipt, error or progress. Receipts are summaries unless detail is full.

Until.description: When a wait for several jobs returns: once `all` have finished, or as soon as `any` has.

detail.description: summary, the default, shortens bulky parts (timing runs to one line per layer, lists to counts) and names them in the result's detail field; full returns everything.

job_id.description: Job ID from the ticket; or give job_ids.

job_ids.description: Several job IDs, up to 64, to wait for in one call. The result lists each job's status with its receipt, error or progress.

job_root.description: Job queue directory used with render.start or job.start. Optional: defaults to .cutbolt/jobs in the workspace.

save_as.description: Write the result to this new workspace .json file and return a summary; pass it on as {"file": path, "select": field}.

timeout_seconds.description: Longest wait in seconds, 1 to 120; default 30. The status is returned either way, with `finished`.

until.description: With job_ids: return once all of them have finished (default) or as soon as any has.

tools.name: cutbolt_job_wait

tools.description: Measure a timeline range's loudness without exporting: sample peak, RMS and BS.1770 integrated loudness (LKFS) of the mix of enabled audio tracks and, by default, of each enabled audio track alone. Use it to set clip gain_milli against a target such as -14 LKFS. With curve, also loudness per second and the silent and clipped runs, to find dead air, music that buries speech, or distortion. Read-only; at most 4 hours per call.

curve.description: Add `over_time`: per-second short-term and loudest momentary LKFS, silent runs (-60 dBFS for 0.5 s or more) and clipped runs, with exact times; default false.

duration.description: Range length in rational seconds, at most 600; default to the timeline end.

input_root.description: Existing directory that project media paths resolve against. Optional: defaults to the workspace.

project.description: Project to measure; its enabled audio is rendered exactly as an audio-only export would be. A full snapshot (cutbolt_schema {"name":"project"}), or {"project_id", "revision"} to load a saved revision (default the head; store_root defaults to the workspace store).

start.description: Range start in rational seconds on a frame boundary; default zero.

tracks.description: Also meter each enabled audio track alone; default true. Each track costs one more audio pass.

tools.name: cutbolt_timeline_meters

tools.description: Find likely mistakes without rendering: flash frames, out-of-sync picture and sound, jump cuts, black or silent stretches, disabled-track clips, unused assets, missing or changed media (with input_root) and words cut by clip edges (with transcripts). Returns a text summary and findings; ok means no warnings or errors. Read-only.

input_root.description: Existing directory that project media paths resolve against; with it, missing and changed media are reported. Optional: defaults to the workspace.

jump_window.description: A cut between touching clips of one source that skips or repeats less than this is a jump cut; default 10 s.

min_clip_frames.description: Shorter picture clips are flash frames, 1-100 frames; default 3.

project.description: Project to check. A full snapshot (cutbolt_schema {"name":"project"}), or {"project_id", "revision"} to load a saved revision (default the head; store_root defaults to the workspace store).

transcripts.description: Transcripts of the source media, as for timeline.outline; with them, words cut by clip edges are reported.

items.description: Content-bound transcript of one source range; returned by transcript.transcribe and edited by transcript.correct. Abbreviated; cutbolt_schema {"name":"transcript"} returns it.

tools.name: cutbolt_timeline_check

tools.description: Read a timeline as compact text, one line per clip (spans, ID, source, link, levels, picture-in-picture), plus transitions and black or silent stretches. With transcripts of the sources, each audio clip shows what is said, a cut word marked *. start and end page through long timelines. Read-only.

end.description: List clips that start before this timeline time; default the timeline end.

input_root.description: Existing directory; used only to match absolute asset paths to transcript source paths. Optional: defaults to the workspace.

project.description: Project to outline. A full snapshot (cutbolt_schema {"name":"project"}), or {"project_id", "revision"} to load a saved revision (default the head; store_root defaults to the workspace store).

sequence_id.description: Outline this child sequence instead of the project's timeline.

start.description: List clips that end after this timeline time; default zero.

transcripts.description: Transcripts of source media, as returned by transcript.transcribe or transcript.correct, at most 256. Each is matched to the assets of its source (by content identity when the asset is bound, otherwise by path), and audio clips then show what is said in them.

items.description: Content-bound transcript of one source range; returned by transcript.transcribe and edited by transcript.correct. Abbreviated; cutbolt_schema {"name":"transcript"} returns it.

words.description: Transcript words shown per clip, 0-2048; default 12. Longer speech shows its first and last words and the word count; 0 shows only the count.

tools.name: cutbolt_timeline_outline

tools.description: List files and folders under input_root (the workspace by default), sorted, with sizes and paths relative to it, optionally recursive and filtered by extension; engine state folders are skipped. Read-only.

dir.description: Relative folder inside input_root to list; omit for input_root itself.

extensions.description: Only files with these extensions, such as `["mkv", "mp4", "wav"]`; folders are then omitted.

input_root.description: Existing directory to list; with a workspace it defaults to the workspace. Optional: defaults to the workspace.

limit.description: Most entries to return, 1-1000; default 200. `total` and `truncated` report the rest.

recursive.description: Also list files in every subfolder; default false.

tools.name: cutbolt_files_list

tools.description: Probe a local source inside an explicit input_root. Returns its content identity (path relative to input_root, SHA-256, bytes), stream metadata and `timeline`: whether the file can go on a timeline as it is, with its exact frame rate, frames, rational duration and a media.add-ready asset, or the reasons it cannot and, for video, a normalization recipe with estimated cache bytes. Add original video with media.add and input_root to save automatic preparation for queued exports. A source longer than media.conform's 45000 output frames gets a reason instead of a shortened recipe.

input_root.description: Existing directory; every source file must lie inside it. Optional: defaults to the workspace.

path.description: Path of the file to probe; it must lie inside input_root.

tools.name: cutbolt_media_inspect

tools.description: Validate the narrow reference media profile and inspect an export plan. Requires input/output roots and an unused .mkv output. May take time to decode source metadata.

input_root.description: Existing directory; every source file must lie inside it. Optional: defaults to the workspace.

output.description: Path of a new .mkv file inside output_root; existing files are never overwritten.

output_root.description: Existing directory; the output must lie inside it. Optional: defaults to the workspace.

project.description: Project to plan; give a saved `revision` for a stable render. A full snapshot (cutbolt_schema {"name":"project"}), or {"project_id", "revision"} to load a saved revision (default the head; store_root defaults to the workspace store).
